name: project_load
description: Compile one SystemVerilog top from explicit ordered source_files. Paths must be absolute and exist; source order and duplicates are preserved. Supply child modules, packages, include_directories and defines explicitly. Missing dependencies remain diagnostics. The top uses standalone parameter defaults; completeness is not verified.

single_unit.description: Compile ordered sources as one compilation unit, sharing macros and compilation-unit declarations. Set false for a separate compilation unit per file.

name: project_info
description: Return build and elaboration information without rebuilding.

name: get_diagnostics
description: Return bounded Slang diagnostics, total_count, truncated and analysis scope. Unknown-module/package scope hints identify possible missing dependencies, never harmless errors. Syntax/type errors remain visible; completeness is not inferred.

name: find_symbol
description: Find semantic declarations by exact name.

name: describe_symbol
description: Describe one semantic symbol by stable id, qualified name, or name.

name: get_hierarchy
description: Return the elaborated instance and generate hierarchy. root accepts an exact elaborated instance or generate-block path, or a top name.

name: get_references
description: Bounded source-level semantic references. kind read_write returns all reads, writes and read-modify-write accesses without duplicate sites. kind read or write also includes read-modify-write accesses; kind port_connection filters port-binding context. No netlist inference.

symbol.description: Stable symbol_id or exact elaborated qualified name, e.g. cpu.bank_sel_ff when cpu is the loaded top. Use the complete instance path within larger tops; a module type name is not an instance path.

kind.description: read_write selects the union of all read/write accesses. Each returned item's kind retains its precise classification; read_write on an item means a read-modify-write access.

scope.description: Symbol identifier or module name for default members, or an exact elaborated instance or generate hierarchy path. A top path identical to a module name selects defaults.

name: list_instances
description: Filter elaborated instances by type, exact name and path prefix.

name: list_instance_facts
description: Selected effective parameters and resolved port connections for every elaborated instance of one module type. Optional parameter_names and port_names select exact names; limit bounds instances and fact_limit bounds each nested collection.

name: get_state_elements
description: Signals written in always_ff; no reset or synthesis inference.

name: inspect_module
description: Module declaration signature and optional elaborated usage sections. Defaults to parameters and ports. Each collection is limited to 100 items by default (maximum 500). For large signatures use parameter_names/port_names; check truncated and total_count.

limit.description: Maximum items per collection after name filtering; unfiltered large collections are truncated.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns parameters and ports. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

name: inspect_instance
description: Effective instance parameters and resolved source-level port connections, with optional children. Defaults to parameters and connections. Each collection is limited to 100 items by default (maximum 500). For large signatures use parameter_names/port_names; check truncated and total_count.

limit.description: Maximum items per collection after name filtering; unfiltered large collections are truncated.

fields.description: Sections to return; omitted returns parameters and connections. Identity is always included.

parameter_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.

port_names.description: Exact names to include, filtered before the section limit.
